notes: Model-1 slice of the LASSO risk-model evaluation pipeline: PROC LOGISTIC with weighted ROC (rocoptions(weighted), nofit, roc pred=pred_prob) against a survey weight1, then PROC UNIVARIATE producing 100 weighted percentile cut points (pctlpts = 1 to 100 by 1), the ventile-category DATA step that bins pred_prob against those cut points, and PROC SURVEYFREQ crosstabbing the ventile categories against outcome_6msa with row/col percentages. Upstream builds the input by PROC IMPORT of an external CSV merged with pha.test_sample from an external libname; autoexec supplies sample1_lasso_pp_test with the three columns the pipeline reads (pred_prob, weight1, outcome_6msa). ROC output dataset retargeted from the external harvrd04 libname to work; ODS destinations rewritten to relative files. The LOGISTIC/UNIVARIATE/ventile/SURVEYFREQ statements are exactly the author's model-1 code.
